## Common family template

**Loop skeleton** (all 16; "hot loop", identical shape modulo the stated deltas):

```c
TEST_LOOP(test, 1 << 13) {                       /* outer timed loop, ≤8192 sweeps */
    /* rowmajor lineage only: */
    const bool ascending = (sweep & 1) == 0;
    for (int n = 0; n < COUNT; n++) {
        const int i = ascending ? n : (COUNT - 1 - n);   /* original lineage: i = n */
        uint64x2_t unused_x = load_vec(&data->scratch[i]); (void)unused_x;  /* DEAD ldr AT TOP */
        uint64x2_t a = load_vec(&data->srcA[i]);          /* useful load 1 */
        uint64x2_t b = load_vec(&data->srcB[i]);          /* useful load 2 */
        switch (i % 4) { /* 0:add 1:eor 2:and 3:orr  — rotating ALU, per-index op mix */ }
        store_vec(&temp[i], res);                          /* back-to-back stores */
        store_vec(&dst[i],  res);                          /* (str3 family: + junk[i]) */
    }
    sweep++;
    if (memcmp(dst, data->expected, COUNT * sizeof(uint64x2_t)) != 0)   /* COLD path */
        report_fail_msg("… data miscompare");
}
```
The probed hardware behavior: a load/store-unit defect on the failing core such that, under this exact micro-op mix — dead load(s) placed *before* the two source loads, 2-source vector ALU, back-to-back stores of one result — stored results occasionally contain wrong bits (measured signature: same-buffer field substitution from a neighbouring word, ±8..±28 elements away, op-biased toward orr/and). The `asm volatile` ldr is non-removable and keeps its position; `vst1q` stores are also not DCE-able because dst is memcmp'd (and temp is dead-but-kept via the volatile-store path only where checked).

**Buffer layout**: COUNT = 1024 elements × 16 B = 16 KiB per buffer (k3res: 4096/64 KiB; k5far/k5inter_rand: interleaved src = 2048 elements/32 KiB; offdiag: interleaved = 3072/48 KiB), all `aligned_alloc(64, …)`. Shared (allocated in `test_init`, child main thread, before per-CPU workers spawn; written only during init, read-only afterwards — race-free by construction): srcA/srcB/scratch(/scratch2)/interleaved-src + expected (golden). Per-thread (allocated inside `test_run`, freed at its end): temp, dst (+ junk in str3 family). This matches the shared-vs-per-thread discipline the sdcshield fork fixed in 1023c841 — keep it in the SVE ports.

**Init golden rule**: expected[i] is precomputed in init with the *same intrinsics, same operand order, same NEON units* as the hot loop, so any runtime mismatch is hardware, not compiler drift. Fill is either `memset_random` (auto-seeded framework RNG, per-run) or a deterministic GPS-tag/pattern fill; deterministic fills replace RNG entirely.

**Cold-path menu** (compose per variant): plain memcmp(dst) → fail (sub, mla, offdiag, str3, ldr4); + per-index log/bin records with cold source re-read (rowmajor_dump, str3_checkall); + five-buffer file dump to `movbe_log/gps_rowmajor/` (gps, dualcmp, k5far, k5inter_rand, k3res, k7p×4); multi-target checks: dualcmp (temp+dst+mutual), str3_checkall (temp+junk+dst slot_mask).

**Porting notes**: no knobs, no `log_skip`, no preinit, no `minimum_cpu`; `TEST_LOOP(test, 1<<13)` fixed; `device_info[cpu].cpu_number` used to map the `cpu` thread parameter to logical CPU in dump records; `dualcmp_classify` uses the GCC `uint64x2_t::operator[]` vector extension; dump dirs `movbe_log/gps_rowmajor` are CWD-relative while `/var/tmp/…_<pid>.bin` is absolute; shared dump fds are appended from all worker threads (single `write()` per record).
